articles.summary: The Professional Airline Flight Control Association (PAFCA) announced today that American’s nearly 600 dispatchers and operations specialists have approved a new five-year contract.
articles.title: American Airlines dispatchers and operations specialists approve new 5-year contract

articles.summary: American will also offer scholarships to students enrolled in AIM’s dual credit Aviation Maintenance Technician (AMT) program, and AIM is offering tuition assistance to anyone working at Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT), regardless of their employer.
articles.title: American Airlines and AIM partner to expand aviation career pathways in Charlotte with new scholarships, tuition support

articles.summary: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ: AAL) today reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reflecting execution of its commercial strategy and the benefits of long-term investments in its customers, team members, network, fleet and technology.
articles.title: American sets new revenue records amid historic fuel cost pressure

articles.summary: American Airlines continues to enhance air service between the United States and Venezuela with new service to Barcelona (BLA) launching Jan. 15, 2027.
articles.title: American Airlines grows Venezuela network with first-ever service to Barcelona

articles.summary: American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL) will webcast a live audio feed of its third-quarter 2026 financial results conference call Oct. 22 at 7:30 a.m. CT.
articles.title: American Airlines Group announces webcast of third-quarter 2026 financial results
